requirements: Backfill 1.2M documents: complete embeddings in <=48 hours (batch window)
Sustained daily ingest: ~100k docs/day with automated batching
Realtime similarity queries: p50 <5ms, p99 <20ms for hot set via Redis/hybrid
End-to-end throughput target: embedding throughput up to 5k rows/min in Dedicated
Vector DB interoperability: Milvus primary, Redis for hot cache; prefer simple connector templates
Model preferences: open models + 8-bit quantized variants for cost, optional fallback to larger model for quality-sensitive queries
Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to cheaper model during peaks; canary rollouts for model versions
Security: SSO/SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retention 12 months, SOC2 evidence
Network: VPC peering option for Dedicated; private control plane preferred for prod tenants
Data residency: ability to pin EU subset — legal needs clarification
use_case_summary: Oxley Bridge is building an embeddings-first semantic search layer for their product analytics UI. Needs: bulk backfill + daily incremental embeddings, low-latency similarity for features like related-reports, instant-recommendations, and FAQ retrieval. Starting with Redwood Hosted API POC; plan to purchase Dedicated reserved capacity if POC meets throughput/cost SLOs.
poc_results_summary: Hosted API POC: ingest pipeline stable; raw throughput ~1,200 rows/min on initial run; pagination and retry logic stable.
Similarity perf: Redis hybrid gave p50 ~4ms, p95 ~14ms for 10k hot vectors; p99 slightly above target (12-20ms) during concurrent queries.
Cost observations: hosted model per-embed unit cost higher for backfill; Dedicated estimated 45-60% lower unit cost for sustained workloads (preliminary sizing).
Open items: Dedicated sizing request (GPU pool configuration), legal redlines on data residency, connector template for Milvus ingestion.
